rachna: Heads-up 1: Aurelia Health wants to do a short case study after their successful migration. Goal: blog + 2-slide webinar promo + social snippets. Need interview, quote approval, benchmark verification, and legal consent. Target publish: Apr 12.
dave_mktg: Nice. Who's available to run the interview and own the narrative?
jules: I can take this one. Prefer 30 mins + record. Can anyone confirm stakeholders at Aurelia?
owen_cs: I'm the CS contact. I'll intro you to their Head of ML (Priya) and ops lead. They'll want to approve any numbers and the wording.
sam_engineer: They shared latency numbers: p50=45ms, p95=220ms after moving to Redwood Inference vs p95~900ms on previous infra. I need to re-run a quick verification on our testbed before we publish.
rachna: Sam, please include hardware/test config in your verification notes (device, batch size, seq len, date). Liz_legal will need that for the copy.
liz_legal: Confirmed. Legal needs: (1) signed marketing consent form, (2) explicit approval for hero quote(s), (3) approval for any comparative claims. Also include source data and date. I can send our short consent template; if they want edits, we'll negotiate.
dave_mktg: Outreach draft for Aurelia intro, please edit: 
``` 
Subject: Redwood x Aurelia Health 1: quick approval
Hi Priya,
Thanks again for working with us. We'd love to feature Aurelia Health in a short case study and webinar promo. Would you be open to a 30-min recorded chat this week? We'll send a short consent form + a draft of the case study and metrics for your sign-off before publishing.
Best,
Dave (Redwood)
```
jules: Looks fine. Add proposed publish window and who signs the consent form.
owen_cs: Intro sent. Priya replied: "happy to chat, week of Apr 1. can share high-level metrics, need to see our draft before publish."
sam_engineer: I'll run the verification on our side tomorrow. Test details I plan to use: A100-80GB, sequence length 512, batch size 4, model variant quantized-int8, measured Mar 28. I'll include the raw logs and commands.
liz_legal: Good. Note for marketing copy: use "customer of Redwood Inference" unless Aurelia requests otherwise. For any comparative sentence like "X% faster than their previous setup" we need the exact prior config and date.
rachna: Understood. Ops question: Hannah out? Who sets up UTM & lead routing once live? ops-bot: @rachna Reminder: standard case-study UTM pattern is utm_source=case-study&utm_campaign=aurelia-apr. Want me to create a template?
dave_mktg: Yes please. Also we want inbound leads to route to growth-triage -> enterprise-AE. Can we get a Slack alert to #growth-leads with a one-line summary?
ops-bot: Zap setup note: will create a webhook to post to #growth-leads containing title, short blurb, landing URL, and utm parameters. Need final publish datetime and URL.
jules: Interview scheduled Thu Apr 3 @11am ET. I'll send calendar invite and a short pre-call doc with questions. Will record.
owen_cs: I'll supply a 1-slide metrics snapshot for the webinar promo (p50/p95, request throughput, user sessions). Please make sure we only publish numbers they sign off on.
sam_engineer: Verification done: our re-run showed p50=48ms, p95=205ms. Differences due to slightly different seq lengths; I included exact command and seed. I'll attach logs and a one-line test config: "NVIDIA A100-80GB, seq=512, batch=4, quant-int8, run Mar 28 2026".
liz_legal: Thanks Sam. I will draft the consent and include a short clause that requires the customer to initial the benchmark table. I'll send the doc to Priya for signature. If they want anonymized numbers, note that too.
dave_mktg: For the blog, we want a short technical callout under "Benchmark methodology" that copies Sam's config. Keep it 1-2 lines. Also a non-technical hero quote 1: one sentence about reliability improvements.
jules: Example hero quote request in pre-call: "Redwood cut our inference latency and stabilized throughput so we could ship feature X faster." We'll ask Priya to approve exact phrasing.
owen_cs: Priya asked to soft-approve metrics during the call and to get the final copy after legal attaches the consent. That's fine.
rachna: Timeline check: Interview Apr 3; Sam sends verification today; Liz sends consent today; Dave compiles initial draft Apr 5; send to Aurelia for review Apr 6; target publish Apr 12. Everyone ok?
dave_mktg: :thumbsup: I'll sync webinar date with product marketing after draft is approved.
liz_legal: I'll prioritize review. If we get signed consent by Apr 6 I can clear copy same day.
sam_engineer: Uploaded logs to the shared drive and posted the one-line config in the docs channel.
jules: After the interview I'll tag quotes in the transcript and send them to legal for faster sign-off.
ops-bot: Checklist reminder 24h pre-publish: logo usage, consent on file, UTM set, Slack alert zap live, assets exported. Link to logo guide: https://redwood.com/brand/logo-guidelines
rachna: Great. Final ask: please keep any comparative claims tied to the exact config lines Sam provided. We'll include a tiny footnote in the blog with the raw numbers and test date. Thanks team.
